display.name: GitHub
display.blurb: Read code, open pull requests and issues — scoped to a per-session GitHub App token.

cli.doc:
Use `gh` to open pull requests and issues from this session. Authentication is automatic — `GH_TOKEN` is a managed placeholder the egress proxy replaces with a short-lived, capability-scoped GitHub App token on every request to api.github.com. Do NOT run `gh auth login` or set a real token.

Open a PR:
1. Re-anchor on the live base (the baked checkout may be stale): `git fetch origin && git checkout -b my-feature origin/main`.
2. Commit + push — git auth is brokered via GIT_ASKPASS, nothing to configure: `git add -A && git commit -m "..." && git push -u origin my-feature`.
3. `gh pr create --base main --title "..." --body "..."` (add `--draft` for a draft). Requires the `pulls:write` capability.

Issues: `gh issue create --title "..." --body "..."` (requires `issues:write`). Images in a PR body must be absolute URLs anchored to a commit SHA — relative repo paths do not render.
